agent.name: Docs Drift
agent.description: Finds statements in a repository's README and docs that the code no longer matches, and proposes the edits as a diff, each backed by the code that shows it.

focus.description: A topic to check, for example "configuration" or "the CLI".

paths.description: Docs to check, for example README.md or docs/setup.md. Defaults to the README and the docs the index finds.

save_note.description: Save the findings and the diff as a note in the project.

project_id.description: The indexed project whose docs to check.

examples.note: Checks the README and the docs the index finds against the code.
Checks one doc's settings against the code that reads them.
Declined: reviewing a pull request is PR Reviewer's job.

agent.name: Memory Gardener
agent.description: Finds duplicate or conflicting decisions and lessons, and stale todos, plans, tasks and reminders, and proposes merges, supersedes and closures for the person to accept.

as_of.description: Judge staleness as of this time instead of now.

focus.description: A topic to tend first, for example "deployment decisions".

kinds.description: What to tend. Defaults to all of them.

dry_run.description: List the proposals without filing them.

stale_after_days.description: How long past its due date an open item must be to look stale (an item with no due date: twice as long untouched). Defaults to 60.

examples.note: The weekly pass: every kind of item, stale after 60 days.
Looks for duplicate or conflicting deployment decisions and lessons first.
Lists stale todos and tasks without filing the proposals.
Declined: it tidies items, it does not summarise them.

agent.name: Repo Guide
agent.description: Writes an onboarding guide for an indexed repository: architecture, where things live, how to build, run and test it, with file:line citations and a diagram.

focus.description: A part of the repository to go deeper on, for example "the billing service".

save_note.description: Save the guide as a note in the project.

examples.note: A guide to the whole repository: its parts, its commands and where to start reading.
The same guide, going deeper on billing.
Declined: changing code is not Repo Guide's job.

agent.name: Lens
agent.description: Reads an image you shared and ties it to your workspace: the text in it, related code, docs, decisions and lessons, and what to do next, with citations.

media_id.description: The image, as a ContextStream media id. Inputs carry references, never bytes.

question.description: What you want to know about the image.

save_note.description: Save the analysis as a note that links to the image.

project_id.description: Search this project for related code.

examples.note: A screenshot of a stack trace: Lens reads it, finds the failing code, and the decisions and lessons about it.
A whiteboard photo: Lens transcribes it and links it to the docs and decisions it matches.
Declined: making files is not Lens's job.

agent.name: Mail
agent.description: Reads your recent mail and writes a digest of what needs a reply, the commitments made and the deadlines coming, and saves reply drafts for you to send. It never sends anything.

as_of.description: Read the window as of this time instead of now.

focus.description: What to look at first, for example "anything from Acme about the renewal".

drafts.description: How many reply drafts to save in your Drafts, at most. 0 saves none. Defaults to 3.

dry_run.description: Put the drafts in the digest without saving them.

mailbox.description: The mailbox to read. Defaults to every mailbox you have, up to three.

reply_style.description: How the drafts should read, for example "short and friendly, signed Ada".

max_messages.description: How many of the newest inbox messages to look at in each mailbox. Defaults to 40.

window_hours.description: How far back to read, in hours. Defaults to 24; a weekly digest uses 168.

examples.note: The daily digest: the last 24 hours of every mailbox, with up to three reply drafts saved.
A weekly digest with no drafts.
Looks at the Northwind renewal thread first and drafts short replies.

input.focus: anything from Northwind about the renewal

examples.note: Declined: it never sends; the person sends the drafts.

agent.name: PDF
agent.description: Makes a PDF from a doc, a plan, notes or markdown in the workspace, with contents, bookmarks and links, and stores it as media.

toc.description: Add a table of contents, or leave it out. Left unset, long documents get one.

paper.description: Paper size: a4 (the default) or letter.

title.description: The PDF's title. Defaults to the source's own title.

doc_id.description: A ContextStream doc to make the PDF from.

plan_id.description: A ContextStream plan to make the PDF from, with its steps and tasks.

markdown.description: Markdown to make the PDF from: notes, a Lens result, anything written down.

doc_title.description: A ContextStream doc to make the PDF from, by its title.

project_id.description: Store the PDF in this project instead of the source's.

instructions.description: How to arrange it, for example "one section per phase" or "put the open questions first".

examples.note: The doc as a PDF, titled and sectioned as the doc is.
The plan with its steps and a table of its tasks, on US letter paper.
Notes the person pasted, under their own title.

input.title: Standup, 17 October
input.markdown:
# Standup notes

- Shipped the importer
- Next: billing

examples.note: Declined: PDF prints the source as it is and does not summarise it.

agent.name: Release Notes
agent.description: Turns the merged pull requests and commits between two refs into user-facing release notes, accounting for every merged pull request, and saves them as a release_notes doc.

base.description: The previous release: a tag, branch or commit, for example v1.2.0.

head.description: The release: a tag, branch or commit, for example v1.3.0 or main.

repo.description: The repository to write release notes for.

title.description: The notes' title. Defaults to the repository and the release ref.

shared.description: Save the notes for the whole workspace instead of as your own.

dry_run.description: Return the notes without saving them as a doc.

audience.description: users (the default) leaves internal changes out of the notes; developers keeps them under Internal.

project_id.description: Save the notes in this project instead of the workspace.

examples.note: Notes for v1.3.0, saved as your own release_notes doc.
What is unreleased on main, internal changes included, not saved.
Declined: reviewing changes is PR Reviewer's job.

agent.name: PR Reviewer
agent.description: Reviews a pull request's diff against the workspace's decisions, lessons and preferences, and returns findings that each cite a line of the diff and the constraint they rely on.

pull.description: The pull request (or merge request) number.

repo.description: The repository the pull request is in.

focus.description: What to look at hardest, for example "error handling" or "the migration".

save_note.description: Save the review as a note in the workspace.

project_id.description: The project whose decisions, lessons and preferences apply. Defaults to the workspace's.

examples.note: Reviews pull request 42 against the workspace's decisions, lessons and preferences.
Looks hardest at the migration.
Declined: fixing failing CI is CI Fixer's job.
